name: KINERGY
recent: Kinergy 近期获得 Gamuda 旗下公司价值约 RM47.5 million 的数据中心电气工程合约，并推进最多 10% 的新股私募计划，已获 Bursa Securities 批准。同时，执行董事 Nazir Hussin 在 MACC 调查期间辞职，创办人 Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 将 8333 万股转入直接持股。
notable: 获得 Gamuda 旗下公司价值约 RM47.5 million 的超大规模数据中心电气工程合约。
497,717 股新股（占已发行股份 10.0%），Bursa Securities 已于 2026 年 10 月 19 日批准上市。
执行董事 Nazir Hussin 辞职，媒体报道其辞职与 MACC 调查有关。
risks: 可能摊薄现有股东持股。
执行董事 Nazir Hussin 在 MACC 调查期间辞职。
创办人兼执行副主席 Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 在 2026 年 10 月 23 日以约 RM3.01 million 增持 8,100,000 股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM109.382 million，环比增长 7.2%，同比增长 11.9%；净利为 RM9.055 million，环比增长 22.8%，同比增长 39.5%；净利率为 8.3%，高于上一季度的 7.2%。

recent_en: Kinergy recently secured an approximately RM47.5 million electrical works contract for a data centre from a Gamuda unit, and is proceeding with a proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares, which has been approved by Bursa Securities. Meanwhile, Executive Director Nazir Hussin resigned amid an MACC probe, and founder Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn transferred 83.33 million shares into direct holdings.
notable_en: Secured an approximately RM47.5 million electrical works contract for a hyperscale data centre from a Gamuda unit.
Proposed private placement of up to 218,497,717 new shares (10.0% of issued shares), with listing approved by Bursa Securities on 19 October 2026.
Executive Director Nazir Hussin resigned; media reported the resignation is linked to an MACC probe.
risks_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Executive Director Nazir Hussin resigned amid an MACC probe.
Founder and Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired 8,100,000 shares for approximately RM3.01 million on 23 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM109.382 million, up 7.2% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was RM9.055 million, up 22.8% QoQ and 39.5% YoY; net margin was 8.3%, higher than 7.2% in the previous quarter.
